functional_plausibility.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
functional_plausibility._check: Could every made object in the frame actually work: fastenings that fasten, straps and cords that go somewhere, strings and cables under the right tension, handles, hinges and controls where a hand could reach them?

object_integrity.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
object_integrity._check: Is every made object complete and symmetrical where its design is symmetrical, with no part fused into another and no edge that dissolves into a smudge?

held_object_function.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
held_object_function._check: Is everything held or worn held or worn the way it is actually used, rather than in a grip or a position that would not work?

text_free.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
text_free._check: Is the image free of text, numbers, signage, logos and watermarks the spec did not ask for, and free of lettering that reads as distorted or nonsensical glyphs?

hand_and_finger_count.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
hand_and_finger_count._check: Does every visible hand have five fingers, and every person the right number of arms, legs and joints, each bending the way a joint bends?

limb_proportion.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
limb_proportion._check: Are the proportions right: neck, arm and leg lengths, head size against body, with no limb stretched or shortened to fit the frame?

face_detail.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
face_detail._check: Do the eyes, teeth, ears and any eyeglasses hold up close: matching pupils and catchlights, a gaze that goes somewhere, teeth that are separate from the lip and gum, frames that rest on the ears and nose?

merged_bodies.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
merged_bodies._check: Does each person own their own body: no shared or merged limb between two people, no arm that belongs to nobody?

hand_object_contact.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
hand_object_contact._check: Does each hand that holds something close around it, with the fingers on the near side in front and the far side hidden?

gaze_and_expression.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
gaze_and_expression._check: Do both eyes point where the spec says, with an expression that fits the action rather than a blank or over-glossy stare?

material_realism.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
material_realism._check: Do skin, hair and fabric read as real material rather than wax, plastic or airbrush, with pores, stray hairs and creases where real ones would be?

resolution_coherence.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
resolution_coherence._check: Does the whole frame look like one photograph: the same sharpness, grain and noise throughout, with no element that looks cut from a different picture?

unposed_credibility.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
unposed_credibility._check: Does the scene look like something that happened rather than a staged shoot: no impossible tidiness, no everybody-in-focus-and-smiling perfection the brief did not ask for?

count_integrity.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
count_integrity._check: Does the image hold exactly the people and objects the spec names, with nothing duplicated, merged or added?

cross_entity_shadows.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
cross_entity_shadows._check: Do the shadows of every person and object run in the same direction, so that one light position explains all of them at once?

shadow_geometry.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
shadow_geometry._check: Do the shadow lengths match one light elevation, and does the line from each object to its own shadow point back toward the same light?

contact_shadows.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
contact_shadows._check: Does everything resting on a surface meet it, with a contact shadow in the gap, so that nothing floats and nothing sinks into the floor?

support_and_balance.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
support_and_balance._check: Is every object supported the way the spec says, and would it stay there under gravity rather than tipping, sliding or hanging from nothing?

shared_vanishing_lines.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
shared_vanishing_lines._check: Do the parallel planes in the frame agree: floor, counter, table and shelf edges converging on one horizon rather than each to its own?

same_ground_plane.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
same_ground_plane._check: Do all the figures stand on one floor, with their feet on a ground plane that recedes consistently, rather than on separate invisible shelves?

horizon_eyeline.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
horizon_eyeline._check: Does the horizon cross each standing person at the height the spec's camera height requires, the same share of their height for everyone of equal height?

relative_scale.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
relative_scale._check: Is every person and object the size its distance requires, measured against the scale anchors in the spec?

occlusion_depth_order.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
occlusion_depth_order._check: Does every nearer thing overlap the things behind it consistently, with no element both in front of and behind the same object?

straight_lines.evidence: <say what is absent from the frame>
straight_lines._check: Do the lines that are straight in the world stay straight and evenly spaced: wall edges, tile grids, window frames, stair treads, shelf fronts?

focus_falloff.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
focus_falloff._check: Does sharpness fall off with distance from the focus plane, with nothing behind a soft plane rendered sharper than it?

reflection_and_transparency.evidence: <say what is absent from the frame>
reflection_and_transparency._check: Does every mirror, glass and glossy surface show what actually stands in front of it, in the right place, and does transparent material bend what is behind it?

fluid_and_fabric.evidence: <say what is absent from the frame>
fluid_and_fabric._check: Do liquid surfaces sit level, pours fall downward, steam rise, and fabric hang and crease under gravity rather than floating or standing stiff?

locale_truth.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
locale_truth._check: Do the local details in the spec read correctly for the stated place: the script on signage, uniforms and dress, plates, plants, architecture, fittings?

negative_space_clean.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
negative_space_clean._check: Is the area the spec reserves for a headline or logo quiet enough to carry type at the published size?

crop_safety.evidence: <what you saw and in which crop>
crop_safety._check: Does the subject survive the crops the spec names, with nothing essential cut at the stated aspect ratios?
